Our People-First Promise

How we invest in our people

We’ve spent two decades earning the trust of the world’s largest enterprises — Salesforce, SAP, Citi, Visa, Best Buy. None of that happens without the people behind it. Every line of code, every customer call, every breakthrough comes from someone choosing to do their best work here.

So we run the company with that in mind. Career paths designed around what you actually want to do. Time off you actually take. And teammates across every continent who treat collaboration like a craft.

🎯
Your career, your way
Work with your manager on a path that fits your goals — not a template. Internal mobility is encouraged, not gate-kept.
🏠
Flexible by default
Remote, hybrid, or in-office — we trust you to choose how you do your best work, with offices around the world when you want them.
💜
Whole-person wellbeing
Comprehensive health coverage, mental health resources, generous time off, and parental leave designed for real life.
🌍
A workplace built for everyone
We hire across cultures, backgrounds, and lived experiences — and we build a workplace where every voice gets weight, not just a seat.

Why You'll Thrive Here

Creating an environment where talent thrives

From professional development to meaningful connections, we’re committed to helping our people succeed.

Career path

Grow on your terms

Career goals are personal. Your manager partners with you on a roadmap built around what you actually want — including a real path to other teams when the timing’s right.

Flexible work

Where you do your best

Remote, hybrid, or office — your call. Offices in Tel Aviv, Paramus, London, Madrid, Braga, Rome, Pune, Mumbai, Bangalore, and Manila when you want them.

Time off

Recharge, for real

Generous PTO. Real parental leave. Holidays observed locally. The kind of time off you actually take — and come back recharged from.

Health

Whole-person care

Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage. Mental health resources. Wellness incentives. Parental leave designed for real life, in every region we operate.

Team & culture

Globally close

Office team-buildings, regional summits, hackathons, family days. Collaboration tools that work across timezones. We feel close even 8,000 miles apart.

Our Offices

Local roots, global team

Wherever you’re based — where offices are available — you’re part of the same conversation. Drop in, set up, or stay remote: it’s your call.

Checkmarx One is an application security software platform built to help enterprises secure every stage of the SDLC while reducing engineering costs and accelerating development. As a leader in agentic application security testing, Checkmarx scans trillions of lines of code each year, helping organizations cut vulnerability density by more than half. Its autonomous security agents detect, prioritize, and counter AI-driven threats across legacy, modern, and AI-generated code at enterprise scale.
